race.comment: STAY HUMBLE (1) continues to race very well, again just finding one better last time out here. Up in trip is interesting, not convinced he wants that but he does everything right up on speed and will be in this a long way in a winnable race. SARAPO (5) won the maiden fresh before getting back here over 1525m and battling late. He should relish the rise in trip now and could settle handier from the inside gate this time. PRINCE OF BYRON (11) won well last time in easier at Moe over 2400m. Back in trip interesting but he can figure. KIWI JENNI (10) is racing well enough for this and the Maher stable are airborne, wouldn't be discounting.
